page.layout: One text page. A woodcut headpiece at the top, then the title block centred in full width, then the body: a woodcut initial and running text in one column, with Greek verse lines set indented within it. The printed signature "A 2" and the catchword "suum" stand at the foot.

main_text.head: THESES MEDICOPHYSICÆ De OECONOMIA NUTRITIONIS in genere Et de SANGUINE, ET CHYLO in specie.
Thesis I.
main_text.p: AUREUM est illud effatum Thebani Lyricorum Poetarum principis prout extat Od. 9. Olymp.

Sunt enim multæ viæ, sed unica meta, Illæ eò faciliores sunt, quò ad scopum rectò tendunt tramite; quidam potius seligunt illam quæ variis ambagibus, quàm quæ recta tendit; & illi quos multa juvant, illi, inquam, homines otiosi multùm laboris defudantes, ἀλλοτριοεπίσκοποι [?], qui rerum haud satagunt suarum, sed alienarum. Hi suam melius agere rem videntur, qui quæ ad artem, quam destinant amplecti, exercendam tractant, & sic recta ad suum

page.notes: The woodcut initial A is joined to the word "UREUM" as "AUREUM". The Greek verse lines and the Greek word ἀλλοτριοεπίσκοποι are transcribed from a small, faint print and may contain errors. The blue spots at the right edge are stains and are left out. The headpiece is an ornament without text.
